name: WMUIMaps
description: Native map surface built on expo-maps, rendering Google Maps on Android and Apple Maps on iOS. Drops pins from a dataset, draws a route between points, and shows the device location. Native only — there is no web preview, so exercise it on a device or emulator.

mapType.name: mapType
mapType.description: Map style. Apple Maps has no terrain style and falls back to standard. Default: standard

customMapStyle.name: customMapStyle
customMapStyle.description: Google Maps style array as a JSON string, used to restyle roads, labels and terrain. Android only.

latitude.name: latitude
latitude.description: Latitude the map is centered on. Rebinding it recenters the map. Default: 12.9716

longitude.name: longitude
longitude.description: Longitude the map is centered on. Rebinding it recenters the map. Default: 77.5946

zoom.name: zoom
zoom.description: Zoom level of the camera. 0 is the whole world, 12 a city, 16 a street and 20 a building. Default: 12

markers.name: markers
markers.description: Rows to drop as pins. A row may also carry color to tint its own pin, imageUrl to replace it with an image, and radius for its own coverage circle. Example: [{latitude: 12.9716, longitude: 77.5946, title: 'Bengaluru'}]

latitudeField.name: latitudeField
latitudeField.description: Row field holding the latitude, in both markers and route path. Default: latitude

longitudeField.name: longitudeField
longitudeField.description: Row field holding the longitude, in both markers and route path. Default: longitude

titleField.name: titleField
titleField.description: Marker row field shown as the callout title. Default: title

descriptionField.name: descriptionField
descriptionField.description: Marker row field shown as the callout subtitle. Android only — an Apple Maps callout has no subtitle. Default: description

markerColor.name: markerColor
markerColor.description: Pin color used when a row carries no color of its own. Tints the pin on iOS; on Android it only tints the radius circle, since a Google pin is recolored by giving it a marker icon. Default: #EF4444

markerIcon.name: markerIcon
markerIcon.description: Image URL drawn in place of the default pin for every marker. A row may override it with its own imageUrl. This is the way to restyle pins on Android.

markerRadius.name: markerRadius
markerRadius.description: Meters of coverage drawn as a tinted circle around every pin, for geofences and service areas. A row may carry its own radius. 0 draws none. Default: 0

routePath.name: routePath
routePath.description: Ordered points drawn as a line across the map, read with the same latitude and longitude fields.

routeColor.name: routeColor
routeColor.description: Stroke color of the route line. Default: #2563EB

showsUserLocation.name: showsUserLocation
showsUserLocation.description: Draw the blue dot for the device location and show the recenter button. Asks for location permission on first render, and stays off if it is denied. Default: false

fitToData.name: fitToData
fitToData.description: Zoom to enclose every marker and route point instead of using the center and zoom. Default: false

height.name: height
height.description: Height of the map surface, as dp (320), a percentage of the parent (50%), or fill to take all the space the page gives it. Leave blank to fill, unless a height is set in the style panel.

interactive.name: interactive
interactive.description: Allow pan, zoom, rotate and tilt gestures. Turn it off for a map inside a scrolling page, so it cannot swallow the scroll. Android only — Apple Maps does not expose gesture toggles. Default: true

onMapReady.name: onMapReady
onMapReady.description: Fires once the map surface is laid out and ready.

onRegionChange.name: onRegionChange
onRegionChange.description: Fires with the new region once the camera settles, carrying latitude, longitude, latitudeDelta, longitudeDelta, zoom, tilt and bearing.

onMapPress.name: onMapPress
onMapPress.description: Fires with the coordinate that was tapped.

onLongPress.name: onLongPress
onLongPress.description: Fires with the coordinate that was long pressed. Android only.

onMarkerPress.name: onMarkerPress
onMarkerPress.description: Fires with the row behind the tapped pin. On Apple Maps this needs iOS 18 or later.
